title: Micron tops Q4 estimates on top and bottom lines, offers strong Q1 outlook - Yahoo Finance

title: Joe Espada to 'move on' from Astros' reaction to fans' boos - ESPN

title: Federal court halts execution of Christa Pike in 11th hour - USA Today
description: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit issued an order the morning of Sept. 30 staying Pike's execution 'until further order of this court.'
